The '''Aramand System Cruiser III''' was an [[Aramandi]] capital ship used in the [[Taler]] navy.

==Characteristics==
The patrol vessel was 140 meters long, could transport ten soldiers and had enough room for 250 tons of cargo. Necessary crew amounted to fifteen people, alongside four gunners. The weaponry included four turreted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
